## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library(openxlsx) # test this library. It should work without Java
library(readxl) # read excel files
library(WriteXLS) # uses Perl and not Java - Java has a licence issue and should not be used at Empa 
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tidyverse_conflicts()
```

## Define the files names of the input excel file

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

filename2_input <- "Data/2_VehicleCompositionNewData.xlsx"
filename23_input <- "Data/23_CompositionDataUpdated.xlsx"
filename31_input <- "Data/31_ComponentMaterial.xlsx"

```

## Define the file name of the output excel file

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

filename35_output <- "Data/35_VehicleComponentData.xlsx"

```

## Load all the sheets of the the component family composotion (% total weigt & % material composition)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

productKeys <- read_excel(filename2_input, sheet = "ProductKeys")
vehicleWeight <- read_excel(filename2_input, sheet = "totalWeight")

composition <- read_excel(filename23_input, sheet = "FutuRaM-ELV")

componentCarRatio <- read_excel(filename31_input, sheet = "componentCarRatio")
componentCarSegmentInput <- read_excel(filename31_input, sheet = "componentCarSegment")
componentAluminium <- read_excel(filename31_input, sheet = "componentAluminium")
componentSteel <- read_excel(filename31_input, sheet = "componentSteel")
componentMagnesium <- read_excel(filename31_input, sheet = "componentMagnesium")

```

## Calculate the mean component ratio for the different car segments and materials

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# calculate the mean 
componentCarSegment <- componentCarSegmentInput %>% group_by(components, segment, year) %>% summarise(meanAluminium = mean(aluminium, na.rm = TRUE), meanSteel = mean(steel, na.rm = TRUE))
componentCarSegment

# Calculate the ratio of the components by segment and material
componentCarSegment <- componentCarSegment %>% left_join(componentAluminium, by = c("components")) %>% mutate(Al_5xxx = Al_5xxx * meanAluminium, Al_6xxx = Al_6xxx * meanAluminium,
                                                                                                                          Al_7xxx = Al_7xxx * meanAluminium, castAluminiumAlSiCu = castAluminiumAlSiCu * meanAluminium,
                                                                                                                          castAluminiumAlSiMg = castAluminiumAlSiMg * meanAluminium) %>% select(-meanAluminium)
componentCarSegment

# Calculate the ratio of the components by segment and material
componentCarSegment <- componentCarSegment %>%
                          left_join(componentSteel, by = c("components")) %>%
                          mutate(mildSteel = mildSteel * meanSteel, HSS = HSS * meanSteel, AHSS = AHSS * meanSteel, UHSS = UHSS * meanSteel,
                                castIron = castIron * meanSteel, stainlessSteel = stainlessSteel * meanSteel, AHSS_DualPhase = AHSS_DualPhase * meanSteel,
                                alloySteel = alloySteel * meanSteel, Others = Others * meanSteel) %>% select(-meanSteel)

componentCarSegment

componentCarSegment <- componentCarSegment %>%
                          left_join(componentMagnesium, by = c("components", "segment", "year")) %>% 
                          rowwise() %>%
                          mutate(reduction_factor = 1 - magnesium,  # Calculate the remaining ratio for the first 5 columns
                                 across(Al_5xxx:castAluminiumAlSiMg, ~ .x * reduction_factor) # Scale down the first 5 columns
                                ) %>%
                          ungroup() %>% # Return to the default ungrouped state for further operations
                          select(-reduction_factor)

# calculate the standard segment
componentCarSegment_standard <- componentCarSegment %>% filter(segment == "C" | segment == "D")
componentCarSegment_standard <- componentCarSegment_standard %>% group_by(components, year) %>% summarise(Al_5xxx = mean(Al_5xxx), Al_6xxx = mean(Al_6xxx), Al_7xxx = mean(Al_7xxx), castAluminiumAlSiCu = mean(castAluminiumAlSiCu), 
                                                                                                    castAluminiumAlSiMg = mean(castAluminiumAlSiMg), mildSteel = mean(mildSteel), HSS = mean(HSS), AHSS = mean(AHSS), UHSS = mean(UHSS),
                                                                                                    castIron = mean(castIron), stainlessSteel = mean(stainlessSteel), AHSS_DualPhase = mean(AHSS_DualPhase), alloySteel = mean(alloySteel),
                                                                                                    Others = mean(Others), magnesium = mean(magnesium), segment = "standard")
componentCarSegment_standard

componentCarSegment <- bind_rows(componentCarSegment, componentCarSegment_standard)
componentCarSegment

```

## Calculate the weight of the differt Magnesium components to obtain the total amount of Magnesium

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

componentCarRatio <- componentCarRatio %>% select(-sum)

# Add the SUV (J) part, which is identical with the respective sedan segment component weight ratio
componentCarRatio_J <- componentCarRatio %>% mutate(segment = recode(segment, "A" = "JA", "B" = "JB", "C" = "JC", "D" = "JD", "E" = "JE", "F" = "JF"))
componentCarRatio <- bind_rows(componentCarRatio, componentCarRatio_J)

# calculate the standard segment
componentCarRatio_standard <- componentCarRatio %>% filter(segment == "C" | segment == "D")
componentCarRatio_standard <- componentCarRatio_standard %>% group_by(components) %>% summarise(ratio = mean(ratio), segment = "standard")
componentCarRatio <- bind_rows(componentCarRatio, componentCarRatio_standard)
componentCarRatio

vehicleWeight_long <- vehicleWeight %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(segment), names_to = "productKeyLevel1", values_to = "weight")

vehicleWeight_long.Petrol <- vehicleWeight_long %>% filter(productKeyLevel1 == "elvPetrol")

vehicleWeightRatio_long.Petrol <- componentCarRatio %>% left_join(vehicleWeight_long.Petrol, by = "segment") %>% mutate(weightratio = ratio * weight)

vehicleWeightRatio_long.Petrol
```

## Prepare componentCarSegment for the combination with vehicleWeight and combine them

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

componentCarRatio <- componentCarRatio %>% left_join(componentCarSegment, by = c("components", "segment"))

componentCarSegementWeight.Petrol <- componentCarSegment %>%
                                            left_join(vehicleWeightRatio_long.Petrol, by = c("segment", "components")) %>% 
                                              mutate(calAl_5xxx = Al_5xxx * weightratio, calAl_6xxx = Al_6xxx * weightratio, calAl_7xxx = Al_7xxx * weightratio, calcastAluminiumAlSiCu = castAluminiumAlSiCu * weightratio,
                                                     calcastAluminiumAlSiMg = castAluminiumAlSiMg * weightratio, calmildSteel = mildSteel * weightratio, calHSS = HSS * weightratio, calAHSS = AHSS * weightratio,
                                                     calUHSS = UHSS * weightratio, calcastIron = castIron * weightratio, calstainlessSteel = stainlessSteel * weightratio, calAHSS_DualPhase = AHSS_DualPhase * weightratio,
                                                     calalloySteel = alloySteel * weightratio, calOthers = Others * weightratio, calMagnesium = magnesium * weightratio) %>%
                                                select(-Al_5xxx, -Al_6xxx, -Al_7xxx, -castAluminiumAlSiCu, -castAluminiumAlSiMg, -mildSteel, -HSS, -AHSS, -UHSS, -castIron, -stainlessSteel, -AHSS_DualPhase,
                                                      -alloySteel, -Others, -magnesium, -productKeyLevel1)
componentCarSegementWeight.Petrol <- componentCarSegementWeight.Petrol %>% mutate(total = calAl_5xxx + calAl_6xxx + calAl_7xxx + calcastAluminiumAlSiCu + calcastAluminiumAlSiMg + calmildSteel + calHSS + calAHSS + calUHSS +
                                                                                              calcastIron + calstainlessSteel + calAHSS_DualPhase + calalloySteel + calOthers + calMagnesium,
                                                                                            totalAl = calAl_5xxx + calAl_6xxx + calAl_7xxx + calcastAluminiumAlSiCu + calcastAluminiumAlSiMg,
                                                                                            totalIronSteel = calmildSteel + calHSS + calAHSS + calUHSS + calcastIron + calstainlessSteel + calAHSS_DualPhase + calalloySteel + calOthers)

componentCar.Petrol <- componentCarSegementWeight.Petrol
componentCar.Petrol
```

## Prepapre the table in such a way that it can be shared with outside organisations

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Remove columns, which are not needed
VDACarCompontents <- componentCar.Petrol %>% select(-ratio)

# Get the order right: Move total to the end
VDACarCompontents <- VDACarCompontents %>% relocate(totalAl, .after = calcastAluminiumAlSiMg)
VDACarCompontents <- VDACarCompontents %>% relocate(total, .after = last_col())

# Name the different columns correctly
VDACarCompontents <- VDACarCompontents %>% rename("component" = "components",
                                                  "weight of car" = "weight",
                                                  "component share of weight" = "weightratio",
                                                  "Al 5xxx" = "calAl_5xxx",
                                                  "Al 6xxx" = "calAl_6xxx",
                                                  "Al 7xxx" = "calAl_7xxx",
                                                  "castAluminium (AlSiCu)" = "calcastAluminiumAlSiCu",
                                                  "castAluminium (AlSiMg)" = "calcastAluminiumAlSiMg",
                                                  "total share of Al" = "totalAl",
                                                  "mild Steel" = "calmildSteel",
                                                  "HSS" = "calHSS",
                                                  "AHSS" = "calAHSS",
                                                  "UHSS" = "calUHSS",
                                                  "cast Iron" = "calcastIron",
                                                  "stainless Steel" = "calstainlessSteel",
                                                  "AHSS (DualPhase)" = "calAHSS_DualPhase",
                                                  "alloy Steel" = "calalloySteel",
                                                  "Others" = "calOthers",
                                                  "Magnesium" = "calMagnesium",
                                                  "total share of Iron & Steel" = "totalIronSteel",
                                                  "total amount of Al, Iron & Steel" = "total")

VDACarCompontents <- VDACarCompontents %>% mutate(component = as_factor(component)) %>% mutate(component = fct_recode(component,
                                                                                                                      "BIW" = "elvBIW",
                                                                                                                      "Brakes" = "elvBrakes",
                                                                                                                      "Chassis" = "elvChassis",
                                                                                                                      "Closures" = "elvClosures",
                                                                                                                      "Driveline" = "elvDriveline",
                                                                                                                      "Powertrain" = "elvPowertrain",
                                                                                                                      "Steering" = "elvSteering",
                                                                                                                      "ThermalManagement" = "elvThermalManagement",
                                                                                                                      "Transmission" = "elvTransmission",
                                                                                                                      "Trim" = "elvTrim",
                                                                                                                      "Wheels" = "elvWheels"))

VDACarCompontents

WriteXLS(c("VDACarCompontents"), ExcelFileName = "Data/VDACarCompontents.xlsx")
```

## Prepara the data for the plotting

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

PlotVDACarCompontents <- VDACarCompontents %>% select(-c("component share of weight"))
PlotVDACarCompontents <- PlotVDACarCompontents %>% rename("weightCar" = "weight of car",
                                                          "totalAmount" = "total amount of Al, Iron & Steel",
                                                          "totalAl" = "total share of Al",
                                                          "totalFe" = "total share of Iron & Steel")

PlotVDACarCompontents

```

## Plot the material composition of the components by car segment

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Select segment A

plot_segmentA <- PlotVDACarCompontents %>% filter(segment == "A")
total_metalA <- plot_segmentA %>% summarise(totalMetal = sum(totalAmount))
total_metalA <- total_metalA %>% summarise(totalMetal = sum(totalMetal))

plot_segmentA_long <- plot_segmentA %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(component, segment, year, weightCar, totalAmount, totalAl, totalFe), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
plot_segmentA_long <- plot_segmentA_long %>% mutate(variable = as_factor(variable)) %>% mutate(variable = fct_relevel(variable, "castAluminium (AlSiCu)", "castAluminium (AlSiMg)", "Al 5xxx", "Al 6xxx", "Al 7xxx",
                                                                                                                      "cast Iron", "alloy Steel", "mild Steel", "stainless Steel", "HSS", "UHSS", "AHSS", "AHSS (DualPhase)"))
plot_segmentA_long


alPalette <- c("#c6dbef", "#9ecae1", "#6baed6", "#3182bd", "#08519c")
fePalette <- c("#fee6ce", "#fdd0a2", "#fdae6b", "#fd8d3c", "#f16913", "#d94801", "#a63603", "#7f2704")
otherPalette <- c("#a1d99b")
mgPalette <- c("#FFFF4D")
materialPalette <- c(alPalette, fePalette, otherPalette, mgPalette)

theme_set(theme(
  # Remove panel border
  #panel.border = element_blank(),  
  # Remove panel grid lines
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey",
                                        size = 0.25,
                                        linetype = 1),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  # Remove panel background
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  # Add axis line
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")
  ))

p1 <- ggplot(data = plot_segmentA_long) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = component, y = value, fill = variable), stat="identity") +
        geom_errorbar(aes(x = component, ymin = totalAmount - 0.2 * totalAmount, ymax = totalAmount + 0.2 * totalAmount, width = 0.2)) +
        geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(totalAmount/weightCar*100, 1), "%"), x = component, y = totalAmount + 0.2 * totalAmount + 2), vjust = 0, size = 4) +
        annotate("text", x = 9, y = 160, label = paste0("Aluminium, Iron and Steel: ", round(total_metalA, 0), " kg (", round(total_metalA/900*100, 0), "%)"), size = 4) +
        labs(x = "Components", y = "Weight of the component (kg)", fill = "Materials", title = "Petrol car - Material composition of different components (A segment car - total weight 900 kg)") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = materialPalette) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, , hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.9))

ggsave("Components/VDAComponents_segmentA.png", plot = p1, width = 11.7, height = 8.3, units = "in", dpi = 300)

total_metalB <- plot_segmentB %>% summarise(totalMetal = sum(totalAmount))
total_metalB <- total_metalB %>% summarise(totalMetal = sum(totalMetal))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#BIW

PlotVDACarCompontents

componentBIW

componentBIW_long <- componentBIW %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(component, segment, year, weightCar, totalAmount, totalAl, totalFe), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
componentBIW_long <- componentBIW_long %>% mutate(variable = as_factor(variable)) %>% mutate(variable = fct_relevel(variable, "castAluminium (AlSiCu)", "castAluminium (AlSiMg)", "Al 5xxx", "Al 6xxx", "Al 7xxx",
```

## Calculate the approximate composition of a C segment BEV

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

CarComponentC <- componentCar.Petrol %>% filter(segment == "C")
CarComponentC <- CarComponentC %>% select(-ratio, -weightratio)
CarComponentC

## Go to BEV weight 

CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentC %>% mutate(weight = 1800)
CarComponentBEV_C

## Add column for the battery material

CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% mutate(batteryMatterial = 0, Cu = 0, permanentMagnet = 0)
CarComponentBEV_C

# Fill in the battery row with values
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% ungroup()
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% add_row(components = "Battery", segment = "C", weight = 1800, calAl_5xxx = 0, calAl_6xxx = 0, calAl_7xxx = 0, calcastAluminiumAlSiCu = 0, calcastAluminiumAlSiMg = 0, calmildSteel = 0, 
                                                   calHSS = 0, calAHSS = 0, calUHSS = 0, calcastIron = 0, calstainlessSteel = 0, calAHSS_DualPhase = 0, total = 4000, batteryMatterial = 400, Cu = 0, permanentMagnet = 0, 
                                                   calalloySteel = 0, calOthers = 0, totalAl = 0, totalIronSteel = 0)

CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calAl_6xxx"] <- 2
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calAl_7xxx"] <- 2
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calcastAluminiumAlSiCu"] <- 20
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calcastAluminiumAlSiMg"] <- 5
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calmildSteel"] <- 0
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calAHSS"] <- 20
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calcastIron"] <- 5
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "calstainlessSteel"] <- 0
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "Cu"] <- 15
CarComponentBEV_C[6, "permanentMagnet"] <- 2.5
CarComponentBEV_C

CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calAl_6xxx"] <- 1.5
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calAl_7xxx"] <- 0.5
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calcastAluminiumAlSiCu"] <- 2.0
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calcastAluminiumAlSiMg"] <- 1.0
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calmildSteel"] <- 5.0
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calHSS"] <- 3.0
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calstainlessSteel"] <- 4.0
CarComponentBEV_C[9, "calalloySteel"] <- 2.5
CarComponentBEV_C

CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% mutate(total = calAl_5xxx + calAl_6xxx + calAl_7xxx + calcastAluminiumAlSiCu + calcastAluminiumAlSiMg + calmildSteel + calHSS + calAHSS + calUHSS +
                                                                                              calcastIron + calstainlessSteel + calAHSS_DualPhase + calalloySteel + calOthers + batteryMatterial + Cu + permanentMagnet,
                                                                                            totalAl = calAl_5xxx + calAl_6xxx + calAl_7xxx + calcastAluminiumAlSiCu + calcastAluminiumAlSiMg,
                                                                                            totalIronSteel = calmildSteel + calHSS + calAHSS + calUHSS + calcastIron + calstainlessSteel + calAHSS_DualPhase + calalloySteel + calOthers)
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% mutate(weightratio = total)

CarComponentBEV_C

# Get the order right: Move total to the end
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% relocate(totalAl, .after = calcastAluminiumAlSiMg)
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% relocate(total, .after = last_col())

# Name the different columns correctly
CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% rename("component" = "components",
                                                  "weight of car" = "weight",
                                                  "component share of weight" = "weightratio",
                                                  "Al 5xxx" = "calAl_5xxx",
                                                  "Al 6xxx" = "calAl_6xxx",
                                                  "Al 7xxx" = "calAl_7xxx",
                                                  "castAluminium (AlSiCu)" = "calcastAluminiumAlSiCu",
                                                  "castAluminium (AlSiMg)" = "calcastAluminiumAlSiMg",
                                                  "total share of Al" = "totalAl",
                                                  "mild Steel" = "calmildSteel",
                                                  "HSS" = "calHSS",
                                                  "AHSS" = "calAHSS",
                                                  "UHSS" = "calUHSS",
                                                  "cast Iron" = "calcastIron",
                                                  "stainless Steel" = "calstainlessSteel",
                                                  "AHSS (DualPhase)" = "calAHSS_DualPhase",
                                                  "alloy Steel" = "calalloySteel",
                                                  "Others" = "calOthers",
                                                  "Magnesium" = "calMagnesium",
                                                  "total share of Iron & Steel" = "totalIronSteel",
                                                  "total amount of Al, Iron & Steel" = "total")

CarComponentBEV_C <- CarComponentBEV_C %>% mutate(component = as_factor(component)) %>% mutate(component = fct_recode(component,
                                                                                                                      "BIW" = "elvBIW",
                                                                                                                      "Brakes" = "elvBrakes",
                                                                                                                      "Chassis" = "elvChassis",
                                                                                                                      "Closures" = "elvClosures",
```

## Get the composition for cathalyt and electronics

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

compositionPetrol <- composition %>% filter(productKeyLevel1 == "elvPetrol" & year == 2020)
compositionPetrol <- compositionPetrol %>% select(-c(totalAlCalculate, castingAlCalculate, extrusionAlCalculate, forgingAlCalculate, sheetAlCalculate,
                                                     castIronCalculate, mildSteelCalculate, HSSCalculate, AHSSCalculate, UHSSCalculate, totalIronSteelCalculate, MgCalculate,
                                                     totalAlloys, totalPPR, EED_total, totalMetals, totalOtherMaterilas, total, engineCable, perMagnet, battery, generatorCable, generatorperMagnet))

compositionPetrol

componentCarPetrol <- componentCarPetrol %>%
  mutate(
    calculatePt = 0,
    calculatePd = 0,
    calculateRh = 0,
    calculateCe = 0,
    calculateLa = 0,
    powerElectronics = 0,
    actuators = 0,
    controllers = 0,
    light = 0,
    cableLike = 0
    )

componentCarPetrol

unique_names <- componentCarPetrol %>% 
  distinct(segment) %>%
  pull(segment)

for (i in 1:length(unique_names)) {
    temp1 <- compositionPetrol %>% filter(segment == unique_names[i])
    temp2 <- componentCarPetrol %>% group_by(productKeyLevel2) %>% filter(segment == unique_names[i])

  componentCarPetrol <- componentCarPetrol %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvCatalyticConverters",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      calculatePt = temp1$calculatePt,
      calculatePd = temp1$calculatePd,
      calculateRh = temp1$calculateRh,
      calculateCe = temp1$calculateCe,
      calculateLa = temp1$calculateLa
    ) %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvPowerElectronics",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      powerElectronics = temp1$powerElectronics
    ) %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvEmbeddedElectronicsActuators",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      actuators = temp1$actuators
    ) %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvEmbeddedElectronicsControllers",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      controllers = temp1$controllers
    ) %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvEmbeddedElectronicsHeadlights",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      light = temp1$light
    ) %>%
    add_row(
      components = "elvEmbeddedElectronicsCables",
      segment = temp1$segment,
      year = temp1$year,
      weight = temp2$weight[1],
      productKeyLevel1 = temp1$productKeyLevel1, 
      productKeyLevel2 = temp1$productKeyLevel2,
      cableLike = temp1$cableLike
    )

  componentCarPetrol <- componentCarPetrol %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))
}

componentCarPetrol
```
